message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find the Law | |-------|------------|-----------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 65 mph on urban interstates (unless posted otherwise)
• 45 mph on rural highways, 35 mph on urban highways (unless posted)
• 25 mph in school zones during school hours | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **Seat‑Belt & Child Restraint** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 4 must be in a rear‑facing seat. | § 545.021 | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero‑tolerance (0.00 %) for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | § 545.041 | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited unless the driver is a passenger or the vehicle is stopped. | § 545.021 | | **Headlights & Signals** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Turn signals must be used at least 100 ft before turning. | § 545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | § 545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a stop sign, crosswalk, or intersection.
• Parking on a shoulder is prohibited unless marked. | § 545.021 | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading or unloading children. | § 545.021 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Drivers must stay in their lane unless turning or passing. | § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Equipment** | • Must have working brakes, lights, horn, and mirrors. | § 545.021 | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 total bodily injury, $25,000 property damage. | § 545.021 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing of vehicles is regulated; towing companies must be licensed. | § 545.021 | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras are used in some counties; fines are issued automatically. | § 545.021 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles, bicycles, and mopeds have specific helmet and lighting requirements. | § 545.021 | --- ### How to Find the Full Text 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic laws. *Online:* https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TS/htm/TS.545.htm 2. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Provides guidelines, maps, and updates. *Website:* https://www.txdot.gov/ 3. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Handles licensing, enforcement, and penalties. *Website:* https://www.dps.texas.gov/ 4. **Texas Legislature Online** – For legislative history and amendments. *Website:* https://capitol.texas.gov/ --- ### Quick Tips for Drivers - **Always check posted speed limits** – they can vary even within the same county. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on the phone. - **Keep your seat belt fastened** at all times. - **Avoid distractions** – no texting, no eating while driving. - **Know your insurance limits** – they’re the minimum required by law. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular aspect (e.g., DUI penalties, school bus rules, or vehicle equipment requirements), let me know and I can pull up the exact statute or provide a deeper dive.
